bio: The simple fact of having the Torres brothers’ name behind it is enough of a guarantee for this restaurant, but if we add in the spectacular setting of the Balcó Gastronòmic at the Port Olimpic with views of its moored yachts and the Nova Icària beach, you’re on to a certain winner. In this restaurant with a casual ambience and large picture windows through which you can enjoy views of the sea and its surroundings, you’ll find an à la carte that has a clear focus on the Mediterranean and its bounty. The numerous options on offer include oysters, delicious rice and fideuá dishes, pasta and meat, plus a special section dedicated to fish of the day. The extensive wine list features over 400 labels....
